notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one other targetable creature on the battlefield.
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
You control a basic Island.
description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Leech Bonder.
Deeprot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping the Island.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, moving a counter from one creature to another creature.
Repeat.
